channel.title: The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: Michigan school board member calls for fed probe over ‘indoctrination’ claims
item.description: A Republican State Board of Education member claims the agency is prioritizing sexual politics over test scores.

item.title: How a sword and SWAT standoff sparked fury over Michigan mental health crisis
item.description: A man with a katana — and a history of mental health issues — sparked a SWAT team response and 30-hour police standoff in southeast Michigan. Critics call it a ‘systemic failure’ that shows how authorities across the state struggle to deal with such situations.

item.title: New allegation against Mott college president emerges
item.description: Did President Shaunda Richardson-Snell pass out unsolicited religious literature to students and faculty? Board attorney says this is a new allegation and recommends outside investigation pending a formal complaint.

item.title: WSU appoints interim president to permanent post without interviewing other candidates
item.description: WSU named law school dean Richard Bierschbach as interim president in September. His leadership has led to a permanent appointment without a national search or interview of other candidates.

item.title: Michigan, Enbridge battle over Line 5 pipeline before US Supreme Court
item.description: Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel’s yearslong lawsuit to shut down the pipeline could come down to how the Supreme Court interprets a 30-day procedural deadline that Enbridge failed to meet.

item.title: Hey, Gov. Whitmer: Here’s what Michigan says is real State of the State
item.description: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer will discuss the State of the State on Wednesday. Here are what the facts — and Bridge readers — say.

item.title: What’s Michigan’s top election issue? Cast your ballot with Bridge Listens
item.description: Make your voice heard. Help Bridge identify the top state issue so we can demand answers from candidates.

item.title: Mold, medical failures alleged at Michigan women’s prison
item.description: Lawmakers are scrutinizing conditions at the Huron Valley Correctional Facility following the death of an inmate from a treatable infection and testimony alleging mold, poor ventilation and unsafe living conditions.

item.title: Report: Michigan lags in preparing students for mental health careers
item.description: Michigan is tied for the fewest behavioral health vocational training programs in the nation, contributing to a school mental health workforce shortage.

item.title: State of Union fact check: Trump honors Michigan athletes, defends tariffs
item.description: President Donald Trump touted Olympics winners, the economy, tax breaks and more in his State of the Union address. Here are the facts.
